name: What each thing gives
text:
Dawn gives the road.
The river gives direction.
The ancestors give memory.
Ṛta gives meaning.

inspired_by.source: Rigveda: Usas the Dawn (1.113), the rivers (10.75), the road of the ancestors (10.14), and Ṛta, which Varuna keeps
inspired_by.note: Original composition after Rigveda: Usas the Dawn (1.113), the rivers (10.75), the road of the ancestors (10.14), and Ṛta, which Varuna keeps. Not a translation, and not a quotation.
